The second DL560 TermAl runner is session-6 "Codex 6", address host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-6, relay principal relay-principal-557b1d0fda0cdfa4a08e3424915ba854e10e701ccf676e42ca4e0d89ef400b16. Created 2026-11-04 on Greg's word „Utwórz poprawnie nową sesję” (relayed by Engram::Asistant), with settings like Codex 3: Codex, gpt-6.1-terra, high, approval never, danger-full-access, workdir /home/greg/github/TermAl, project-b7327333-6e78-4e54-9196-fc63ab99937b. session-5 on DL560 is held at an MCP approval prompt; don't use it.
Working rules: never detach a job with nohup and end the turn, because nothing wakes the session on completion. A message can't reach a runner in the middle of a FULL unless it was told to check mail between steps, so don't route new requests to a runner inside a FULL. Check its state from Central only: the session listing, termal_read_mailbox_message on the GO's message id, or the runner's own START and END mail.
Revised 2026-11-21 under Greg's SSH ban (memory satellite-work-via-federation-not-ssh-2026-11-21): the earlier text described creating and checking the session 'over ssh dl560'. That route is banned for agents; work reaches DL560 only through its remote sessions and federation mail.
